name: 3Code et Bouteilles à la Mer
capabilities: declare physical object or photocopy with claimed lineage
resolve ambiguous public codes without assuming uniqueness
request an email-receipt-based registration when a mailbox is configured
review voluntary contributions without identifying holders
print a customized tract with QR and optional handwritten child and parent code

data_policy.email_proof: An independently trusted mailbox adapter must confirm an actually received email. A typed address does not count.
data_policy.limitations: Email receipt is not proof of civil identity, political endorsement, or physical ownership. Email intake may not be configured.
